reasoning_summary: The previous best setting has been stable across rounds but the overall CV R² variability remains high, so this grid focuses on small-to-moderate neighborhood sizes and both distance weighting options to reduce sensitivity to fold composition while still allowing enough flexibility to avoid underfitting.
search_strategy: Use a compact grid centered on the previously best neighborhood size, expanding to nearby n_neighbors values and testing both Minkowski-compatible distance settings plus the direct Euclidean/Manhattan metrics. Keep the grid within the candidate budget while emphasizing configurations that may smooth predictions and improve robustness.
expected_effect_on_overfitting: Slightly reduce overfitting risk by exploring larger neighborhoods and distance weighting, which can smooth local noise and reduce dependence on individual training points.
expected_effect_on_underfitting: Should not materially increase underfitting risk; the inclusion of smaller k values and both p norms preserves enough local flexibility to fit the data.
computational_cost_estimate: 30 total combinations; low computational cost for n_train=21 and 7 features.
warnings: For metric='euclidean' and metric='manhattan', p is ignored by sklearn KNeighborsRegressor; this is included only to keep the grid compact and compatible with Minkowski-based comparisons.
With a very small dataset, CV variance may remain high even if mean performance improves.
